items.title: Volunteer
items.description: Join our team of young advocates working on diplomacy, research and campaigns. We need writers, designers, translators, researchers and event organizers, and people ready to engage their own elected representatives.

items.title: Raise Your Voice
items.description: Share our work, write to your elected representatives, and ask them where they stand on the Tamil genocide. Politicians act on what their voters raise, so raise it.

items.title: Partner With Us
items.description: We work alongside diaspora organizations, human rights groups and civil society partners. If your organization stands for justice and accountability, let's build pressure together.

items.title: Support Our Work
items.description: We are volunteer-run and funded entirely by the diaspora. A monthly or one-time donation keeps our advocacy in Geneva and Brussels going.
